screened_candidates.title: Deep temporal models and active inference
screened_candidates.exclusion: Constructed lexicon and grammar; no natural-corpus parameter fit or held-out language-modeling score.

screened_candidates.title: Generative models, linguistic communication and active inference
screened_candidates.exclusion: Constructed Twenty Questions simulation; no natural-corpus fit or held-out language-modeling score.

screened_candidates.title: Active listening
screened_candidates.method_note: Discrete lexical states generate continuous acoustic signals. Segmentation selects among already sampled intervals by variational free energy; section 5.1 explicitly distinguishes this from expected free energy for planning future observations.
screened_candidates.exclusion: Simulated auditory input and demonstration rather than a natural speech corpus with a held-out language-modeling score.

screened_candidates.title: Development of Compositionality and Generalization through Interactive Learning of Language and Action of Robots
screened_candidates.exclusion: Neural predictive-coding and active-inference robot simulation over constructed language-action tasks, not a discrete corpus-fitted language model.

screened_candidates.title: Integrating large language models and active inference to understand eye movements in reading and dyslexia
screened_candidates.exclusion: Linguistic predictions come from an external large language model; active inference models eye movements rather than fitting and scoring its own linguistic distribution.

screened_candidates.title: Curiosity-Driven Development of Action and Language in Robots Through Self-Exploration
screened_candidates.exclusion: Active inference is amortized with Q-learning in a constructed imperative-sentence robot simulation; no discrete natural-corpus language model or held-out language-modeling score.

screened_candidates.title: A Framework for Inherently Safer AGI through Language-Mediated Active Inference
